MicMyDay 0.9.6

  • The trial now lasts fourteen days, which is what it was always meant to be. A trial already under way keeps the days it has and gains the difference.

MicMyDay 0.9.5

  • Setup now asks how the overlay should look, with the real overlay on screen while you choose, so the first time you see it is no longer the first time you dictate.
  • Obsidian is the Dock's new default design. A design you picked yourself is left exactly as it was.

MicMyDay 0.9.4

  • Insert again and edit selection now wait for the shortcut keys to come up before pasting. Pressed quickly, they used to paste nothing at all and say nothing about it.
  • The Dock indicator can wear one of several looks, chosen in Settings.
  • The live preview opens in one movement instead of growing a line at a time: until the first word it is the indicator you already know, and then it is that indicator with four rows of text.
  • The newest line of a long dictation stays on screen rather than scrolling out of reach.

MicMyDay 0.9.3

The first public release.

  • Hold your shortcut, speak, and the words land in whatever app you were already in.
  • Transcription runs on your Mac with Whisper, Parakeet or Nemotron, or through OpenAI or Gemini if you prefer.
  • Rewrite profiles turn what you said into a tidied note, a message, or an instruction for a coding agent.
  • A recording with no voice in it is dropped rather than guessed at.
